title: Case Knowledge — Candidate Case (Phase 4D-1)
description: Machine-readable contract for an INTERNAL candidate case. A candidate is NOT a public case. It lives only under internal/candidates/ until a human promotes a fully-reviewed candidate into prototype/assets/cases/. This schema is the single source of truth for the controlled enums; internal/candidate-validate.py reads $defs from this file. Semantic rules (status state-machine, agent_inferred gating, promotion block) are enforced by the validator, not expressible here.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Must equal one of $defs.schema_versions.

candidate_id.description: Stable internal id. Format: cand-<ascii-kebab-slug>-<4-digit-B.E.-year>. Unique within a validation scope. Not a public case id and never derived from an array index or nodeKey.

title.description: Working title. For fixtures, must clearly state it is synthetic / not a real case.

source.description: Provenance. A candidate with no real source is invalid.

ref.description: Human-checkable pointer into the source: lecture code + ครั้งที่, textbook + page, ฎีกา number, or URL. Must not be empty.

notebook.description: Optional NotebookLM notebook id, for a researcher to re-open the source. The repository never calls NotebookLM.

quote.description: Optional verbatim sentence from the source that triggered this candidate.

claimed_citation.description: What the SOURCE says the citation is. May be null / partial for an early candidate. Never invented.

cited_provisions.description: Provisions the candidate is associated with, each tagged with how strongly the source supports it.

ref.description: "<collection>:<article-number>" — the SAME association key Phase 4C uses. Not modified here.

candidate_structural_path.description: DERIVED from a verified provision via AtlasCore public structural lookup (getBreadcrumb / describePath). Never hand-authored as authority; never an array index.

collection.description: Must be a key in collections-registry.json (validator checks).

path.description: Ordered structural VALUE strings (e.g. ["บรรพ 5","ลักษณะ 1","หมวด 2"]). Every element MUST be a string — an integer element means an array index was used as identity and is rejected.

possible_duplicate_of.description: Existing public case ids or other candidate_ids this may duplicate. Advisory; a human decides merge-vs-new at promotion.

reviewers.description: Append-only human-review log. One entry per status transition.

action.description: Optional. "cleared_agent_inferred" is required (on the entry that reaches mapping_verified or later) when any cited_provision has evidence == agent_inferred.

promoted_case_id.description: Public case id this candidate became. MUST be null unless status == "promoted". Setting this is a MANUAL human act in a later phase; no tooling in Phase 4D-1 writes it.

status_requirements.source_verified: + factual_summary, legal_issue, >=1 reviewer entry ending at source_verified
status_requirements.citation_verified: + claimed_citation.case_number non-null, >=1 reviewer entry ending at citation_verified
status_requirements.mapping_verified: + >=1 cited_provision; every provision has a valid evidence; candidate_structural_path present with evidence=derived_from_provision and registry-valid collection; any agent_inferred provision cleared by a reviewer entry with action=cleared_agent_inferred
status_requirements.content_reviewed: + a reviewer entry ending at content_reviewed (deident + paragraph + render review done out-of-band)
status_requirements.promoted: + promoted_case_id non-null; reviewer entry ending at promoted. NOTE: Phase 4D-1 tooling never produces this state.
